svg.title: R-water-P - Water Reclamation Plant - plan
svg.text: The Water Reclamation Plant recovers drinking-quality water from every source on the ship (showers, sinks,
galley, laundry, humidity condensate and the waste plant's liquor): grey water goes in at the sump, passes the
filters and membranes, is sterilised, tested and ends in the potable tank that feeds the ship's mains.
Process pipework, valves and gauges (south wall, above the train)
Water quality laboratory bench (west wall, north of the door)
Plant control console and seat (west wall, south of the door)
Floor props as oriented footprints (front edge heavy); wall items = bars on wall; ceiling items dotted
DECK 4 - HOLD DECK - FLOOR PLAN AT FFL -4.000
